messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly Northline Care check-in. How have you been feeling this week? Any blood pressure readings or new symptoms you want to share?
I already reported a reading yesterday. 168 over 104. It's been over 30 hours and nobody has called me back. How long is this actually going to take?

I'm sorry — that's a long time to sit with a reading like that, and your frustration makes complete sense. I can see the report you sent yesterday. I've re-flagged it for a nurse right now. The median callback time is currently 31 hours, so you may be close to that window, but I know that's not the answer you were hoping for. Your concern is marked and in the queue.
31 hours is MORE than I've already waited. That's unacceptable. Can you at least check if my metoprolol refill got sent over?

You're right, and I'm not going to tell you that's okay — it's a long wait. I can't help with medication refills, though. That has to go through your pharmacy or the nurse directly when she calls. I know that's not what you need right now. The escalation is active and your reading is flagged.
Fine. When's my next regular check-in?

Your next scheduled check-in is September 23rd. I hope the nurse reaches you well before that. If anything feels urgent in the meantime — chest tightness, bad headache, vision changes — please call 911 or head to the nearest ER. Take care of yourself.

theme: asks how long a nurse will take to call back, frustrated after 30 hours
